terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of {app} (the "Panel"), including its server, website, mail, database, DNS, backup, AI Gateway, and AI Chat Engine features. By accessing or using the Panel, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

s1.title: 1. Use of the Panel
s1.li1: You must be authorized by the Panel's administrator to hold an account, and are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and any API keys or tokens you configure.
s1.li2: You agree to use the Panel only for lawful purposes and in accordance with the acceptable-use policies of any third-party service you connect (AI providers, Telegram, Facebook, hosting/DNS providers, etc.).
s1.li3: Access levels (admin, reseller, general user) are assigned by the administrator and determine which features and data you can view or modify.

s2.title: 2. Third-Party Services & API Keys
s2.p1: Certain features require you to supply your own credentials for third-party services — for example, AI provider API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, etc.), Telegram bot tokens, or Facebook Page access tokens. You are solely responsible for:
s2.li1: The validity, security, and lawful use of any credentials you provide.
s2.li2: Any charges, rate limits, or usage incurred with the third-party provider as a result of requests made through the Panel.
s2.li3: Complying with that provider's own terms of service and content policies.
s2.p2: We are not responsible for the availability, accuracy, or content of responses generated by third-party AI providers, nor for the actions of third-party messaging platforms.

s3.title: 3. AI-Generated Content
s3.p1: The AI Gateway and AI Chat Engine features use third-party AI models to generate text and replies, including automated replies sent to your customers or contacts on connected channels (Telegram, Facebook Messenger, and Facebook comments). AI-generated content may be inaccurate, incomplete, or inappropriate in some cases. You are responsible for reviewing and moderating AI auto-reply behavior (including via the AI on/off toggle and system prompts) and for any consequences of messages sent automatically on your behalf.

s4.title: 4. Acceptable Use
s4.p1: You agree not to use the Panel to:
s4.li1: Send unsolicited bulk messages ("spam") through connected channels, or otherwise violate the messaging platform's policies (Telegram, Meta/Facebook, etc.).
s4.li2: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any system, account, or data, including through the Panel's webhooks or APIs.
s4.li3: Upload, generate, or transmit content that is unlawful, infringing, or that violates the rights of others.
s4.li4: Interfere with or disrupt the integrity or performance of the Panel or connected third-party services.

s5.title: 5. Service Availability
s5.p1: The Panel is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation, including for scheduled/broadcast messages, webhook processing, or AI responses, which may depend on the availability of third-party services outside our control.

s6.title: 6. Data & Backups
s6.p1: While the Panel provides backup and recovery tools, you remain responsible for maintaining your own copies of critical data. We are not liable for data loss resulting from misuse of the Panel, third-party service outages, or events outside our reasonable control.

s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
s7.p1: To the maximum extent permitted by law, {app} and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Panel, including damages resulting from AI-generated content, third-party service failures, or actions taken through connected channels.

s8.title: 8. Termination
s8.p1: Access to the Panel may be suspended or terminated at any time, with or without notice, for conduct that violates these Terms, applicable law, or the policies of a connected third-party service.

s9.title: 9. Changes to These Terms
s9.p1: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of the Panel after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

s10.title: 10. Contact Us
s10.p1: Questions about these Terms can be directed to {contact}.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {app} ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you use this control panel to manage servers, websites, mail, databases, and related services, including the AI Chat Engine and AI Gateway features.

account.label: Account information
account.text: name, email address, role/permissions, and authentication details (including two-factor setup) for panel users.

hosting.label: Server & hosting data
hosting.text: configuration and metadata for the websites, mail accounts, databases, DNS zones, and backups you manage through the panel.

logs.label: Operational logs
logs.text: request logs, audit trails, and usage records (e.g. AI Gateway request/usage logs) kept for security, billing accuracy, and troubleshooting.

chat.label: AI Chat Engine data
chat.text: messages, comments, and contact details (name, platform ID) exchanged through connected channels such as Telegram and Facebook, along with the AI-generated replies and any system prompts you configure.

creds.label: Third-party credentials
creds.text: API keys and access tokens you provide to connect external services (AI providers, Telegram bots, Facebook Pages, WHMCS, SSH targets, etc.), stored so the panel can act on your behalf.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Information
s2.li1: To operate, secure, and maintain the panel and the services you manage through it.
s2.li2: To process AI requests — when you use the AI Gateway or AI Chat Engine, message content is sent to the AI provider you've configured (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) solely to generate a response; each provider's own terms and privacy practices apply to that processing.
s2.li3: To send messages on your behalf through connected channels (Telegram, Facebook Messenger, feed comments) as configured by you, including AI auto-replies and scheduled/broadcast messages.
s2.li4: To monitor for security incidents, abuse, and to maintain audit logs required for reliable operation.
s2.li5: To communicate with you about your account, service status, or changes to this policy.

s3.title: 3. Sharing of Information
s3.p1: We do not sell personal information. Data is shared only:
s3.li1: With third-party AI providers, messaging platforms, and other services you explicitly connect and configure (their own privacy policies govern their processing of that data).
s3.li2: With infrastructure providers necessary to host and run the panel.
s3.li3: When required by law, legal process, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of the panel operator, its users, or others.

s4.title: 4. Data Retention
s4.p1: Account and configuration data is retained for as long as your account is active. Operational and request logs (including AI Gateway usage/request logs and Chat Engine conversation history) are retained for as long as needed for security, billing, and troubleshooting purposes, and may be cleared periodically or on request.

s5.title: 5. Security
s5.p1: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards — including access controls, role-based permissions, two-factor authentication support, and webhook signature verification for connected channels — to protect information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

s6.title: 6. Your Choices
s6.li1: You can disconnect a channel (Telegram, Facebook Page) or AI provider at any time from the panel, which stops further data from being sent to it.
s6.li2: You can turn off AI auto-reply per conversation or per channel and switch to manual replies.
s6.li3: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your account data by contacting us using the details below.

s7.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
s7.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of the panel after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

s8.title: 8. Contact Us
s8.p1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us at {contact}.
